name: Scattering Lab
description: The virtual scattering lab: measures the random-incidence scattering coefficient of a sample in the octave bands. The geometric method runs when its inputs change (seconds); kirchhoff and bem take minutes to hours and start only when Run is pressed.

inputParameters.name: method
inputParameters.description: 'geometric' (seconds), 'kirchhoff' or 'bem' (minutes to hours; they start with Run).

inputParameters.name: preset
inputParameters.description: Optional. The measurement's size: 'survey', 'standard' or 'fine'; empty is the method's own (standard).

inputParameters.name: n_rays
inputParameters.description: Optional. Geometric method only: the number of rays.

inputParameters.name: cache_dir
inputParameters.description: Optional. The bem method only: NumCalc's project folder, so that an interrupted run resumes.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: Press to run. The geometric method runs when the inputs change; kirchhoff and bem take minutes to hours and run only when this is true; a button is added when it is not connected. Press again to run again with the same inputs.

outputParameters.name: scattering
outputParameters.description: Scattering coefficient of the 7 octave bands, 125 to 8000 Hz.

outputParameters.name: diffusion
outputParameters.description: Diffusion coefficient of the simulated octave bands; empty when the result has none.

outputParameters.name: octaves
outputParameters.description: The simulated octave bands, in Hz.
